name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in video frames without bloating compute time, giving a measurable quality bump for minimal cost. The trade-off is extra setup work—installing ComfyUI and wiring the node—but the model’s open-source status and zero licensing fees make it the fastest path to a 0.5%+ lift.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t touch EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a spatial fix, not temporal. Try SD3.5-Ultra’s motion-refiner first; its black-box nature is a risk, but we can benchmark it against our current pipeline on a 10-second clip. If it drops frames or adds artifacts, fall back to a temporal denoiser like RVRT—proven on real video, not just static frames.
